item.text: I'll take the latest row per device type (by date, then row order) and get its `balance_after`.

item.command: /bin/sh -lc 'python3 io.py query "SELECT device_type, balance_after FROM (SELECT device_type, balance_after, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_type ORDER BY date, ROWID) AS rn FROM device_inventory) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY balance_after, device_type"'
